text: In 1859, America and Britain almost went to war over a pig.
Both countries claimed the same small island, and nobody had settled who owned it.
Then an American farmer found a British pig eating his potatoes, and shot it.
He offered 10 dollars. The owner wanted 100.
So America sent soldiers. And Britain sent warships.
Soon, 461 Americans with 14 cannons faced 5 warships carrying 2,140 men.
Then a British admiral arrived, and refused to start a war over a pig.
Instead, the two armies shared the island, for 12 years.
They visited each other on holidays, and held sports days.
In 1872, the German emperor gave the island to America.
Nobody ever apologised to the pig.
